# engagelab-email (Node.js SDK)

> Node.js SDK for EngageLab Email sending APIs — normal, template, calendar and MIME email sends.

Install: `npm install engagelab-email`
Requires: Node.js >= 18.

Sending APIs (base URLs: Singapore `https://email.api.engagelab.cc`, Turkey `https://emailapi-tr.engagelab.com`):

- `POST /v1/mail/send` — normal email
- `POST /v1/mail/sendtemplate` — template email
- `POST /v1/mail/sendcalendar` — calendar email
- `POST /v1/mail/send_mime` — MIME email

Related tools:

- CLI `@engagelabemail/cli` (https://github.com/Metaverse-Cloud/engagelab-email-cli) — agent mailbox workflows
- MCP server `@engagelabemail/mcp` (https://github.com/Metaverse-Cloud/engagelab-email-mcp) — for Model Context Protocol clients

Docs: https://github.com/Metaverse-Cloud/engagelab-email-node#readme
